The formula K = e^(-ΔG°/RT) is explicitly required by Topic 9.5 (EK 9.5.A.2). All symbols are correctly defined, and the caution accurately addresses the common unit mismatch trap (kJ vs J) as well as the qualitative relationships described in EK 9.5.A.3 and 9.5.A.4.

Topic 9.5.A.2 gives “K = e−ΔG°/RT.” The entry defines every symbol in that expression, and its energy-unit constraint is correct. Its sign and near-zero cautions match 9.5.A.3–4: ΔG° near zero gives K close to 1; ΔG° < 0 gives K > 1; and ΔG° > 0 gives K < 1. Topic 9.5 is the required location for this relationship.
